purpose: Teach: 辻/ぃ/にゃ/かぁ/るる/之/燭/頁

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「辻のお地蔵さんに挨拶を」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad mentioned stopping by to greet the Jizo statue at the corner.
lines.style: Gentle, warm observation. Soft opening. Unhurried pace—she's sharing a small, tender detail she noticed. Slight lift at the end, like she's inviting him into the moment with her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「これ、楽しぃ」って言ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I told Dad that I was having fun.
lines.style: Bright, direct voice. Quick energy—he's eager to share what he said. Open-faced, wanting to be heard. A small swell of pride at the memory.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがおうちの猫に「にゃ」って呼ばれてたわ
lines.en: Sho, I heard your dad even got greeted by the house cat.
lines.style: Quiet amusement underneath. A small smile in the voice. Slow, savoring the image. Like she's remembering something genuinely endearing about him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「そっかぁ」って受け止めて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad really listened to me when I said that—he didn't just brush it off.
lines.style: Serious, sincere tone. No brightness here—he's saying something that mattered. Steady pace. The careful words of a child recognizing real attention.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが古い童謡で「るるる」と歌って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad actually sang an old folk song for us—humming along the whole way.
lines.style: Tenderness throughout. Gentle onset. Slow, deliberate pace—she's lingering on the memory. Warm breath on the words. A trailing softness, like she's holding the image close.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「之」の意味を教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad even took the time to explain what that kanji character means.
lines.style: Quiet wonder in the voice. Thoughtful pace—he's reflecting on the kindness of being taught. Slight emphasis on 'explained,' not boastful but genuinely moved.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが法要で燭を点して下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad will be lighting the candles at the ceremony.
lines.style: Reverent, hushed tone. Respectful formality—this is important. Slow, measured pace. A note of dignified grace beneath the words.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに絵本の最初の頁を読んで頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad read the first page of the picture book to me.
lines.style: Soft contentment with a closing warmth. Relaxed, settled voice—he's safe in this memory. Gentle pace that winds down like the end of a bedtime story.
